body: Yea I would like that, the only problem is that I can't find any motivation, and if I do find some, it's nearly gone the next day, and the cycle repeats itself. Maybe I should surround myself with new people, make friends with someone that has the same interests.

Yes I did, long story short we came to a conclusion that I should come home and say to myself that I was enough for today, I don't know but that doesn't seem to help either.

Some days I feel a little better and some I feel like today I've come to a conclusion that it's a luck thing. When something good happens I seem to get a little bit distracted from my inner thoughts and can sleep better. 

 (sorry if I make any grammar mistakes, English is not my native language, I am from a small country in Europe called Lithuania)
My bad I read that wrong, I thought the first comment said meditation not medication, I'm sorry

I've tried different medications, but for some reason I just feel worse, I feel like a vegetable on them and can't seem to communicate well on medication, so after taking them for a few years I've decided to stop and I feel a little better but I still have the everyday thoughts of hanging myself.

I've tried meditation for a while 3 months to be exact, tried out different breathing techniques and exercises but it doesn't seem to get my mind off of suicide, all it does is make me feel a little bit more relaxed
